slides.text:
How to Think for Yourself Again

(The Black Sheep Method)

1. Notice the script

“Whenever you find yourself on the side of the majority, it is time to pause and reflect.” – Mark Twain

Most of what you believe about
• success
• food
• what a “normal” life looks like

was handed to you. You never CHOSE it.

No one talks about this -

The black sheep isn't rebelling for attention.

They just stopped saying yes to things that never felt right:
• the 40-year grind for a 2-week vacation
• scrolling instead of living
• “that's just how it is”

They QUESTIONED it. That's all.

2. Question one thing today

Pick one habit you never actually chose.

Ask yourself:
• Who taught me this?
• Does it make me freer, or just busier?

Write your answer down. Right now.

3. The final framework

How to unplug without losing your people:

1. OBSERVE before you judge

2. ASK questions instead of preaching

3. LIVE the change so it speaks for you

4. FIND the others who see it too

4. Walk as the black sheep

Remember - you don't need the herd to agree with you.

You were never meant to blend in. You were meant to WAKE UP.

This is the Key.

Save this for the day you feel like the only one.
